Bear Claw is an AI\-powered recruiting and applicant tracking platform built to help recruiters work smarter and place top talent faster. Our platform brings the entire recruiting workflow into one system — from candidate and job management to team collaboration, sourcing, and outreach. At the center is Cora, our conversational AI assistant, which uses vector search and LLM\-powered technology to identify candidate\-job matches, surface opportunities, and help recruiters take action faster. Bear Claw combines powerful recruiting technology with practical AI to make the hiring process more efficient, intelligent, and scalable.
